waypoints.name: Mosquito Flat Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From US-395 at Tom's Place, turn south on Rock Creek Road and drive about 10 miles to the road end at Mosquito Flat, about 10,250 ft. A wilderness permit is required for overnight trips.

waypoints.name: Bear Creek Spire
waypoints.directions: Follow the Little Lakes Valley trail south about 3.5 miles; just past a creek crossing, take the signed climbers' trail to Gem Lakes. From Gem Lakes climb up and left across talus toward Dade Lake to the base of the North Arete, then climb the arete to the summit block.
